The shapes are defined in the hidden tests, so Summary can't switch on their concrete types. It can ask each Shape value at runtime whether its dynamic type also has a Perimeter() float64 method. That question is a type assertion to an interface.

Declare type perimeterer interface { Perimeter() float64 }. In the loop, build "area %.2f", then: if p, ok := s.(perimeterer); ok { append ", perimeter %.2f" with p.Perimeter() }. Join the lines with "
".
